evidence: app/src/app/abilities/[name]/page.tsx — the whole Abilities feature lives in one route directory with no nav link (nav is Pokémon/Types/Team only, app/src/app/layout.tsx:23-33)
app/src/app/pokemon/[name]/page.tsx:116-124 — the only inbound links: the Abilities section must be edited out of the Pokémon page
app/src/lib/api.ts:194 (getAbility) and api.ts:143-148 (ApiAbility) — small cleanup in the data module
app/src/components/pokemon-cards.tsx:20 — card.hiddenAbility 'Hidden ability' note is abilities-feature state leaking into the shared card component
app/src/app/globals.css:227 — .card-note rule to delete; CSS is sectioned by feature comments so the cut is easy to find
removability.rationale: Features are route-directory-shaped and the nav has no dangling links, but Abilities leaks a `hiddenAbility` field through the shared CardData/PokemonCard and an inbound section in the Pokémon page, so removal is delete-a-directory plus three small edits rather than one.

evidence: app/src/lib/api.ts:274 — spriteUrl() is the single sprite-URL source, called from one place (pokemon-cards.tsx:11), so a sprite-pattern fix covers every list of cards
app/src/lib/api.ts:5-7,18-20,43-53,274-281 — API base URL, cache TTL/LRU, fetch options and media rewriting all in one module
app/src/app/pokemon/[name]/page.tsx:44-49 vs app/src/app/team/page.tsx:33-35 — the 'default variety → Pokémon' resolution is duplicated verbatim; a Deoxys-style fix lands twice
app/src/app/page.tsx:25-33 vs app/src/app/filters.tsx:10-17 — two hand-rolled FilterValues→query-string builders that must stay in sync when a filter param changes
app/src/app/team/page.tsx:41-48 — team page builds CardData inline instead of via lib/api
changeability.rationale: Most fixes land in one obvious place (lib/api.ts, lib/format.ts or a shared component), and the sprite-URL bug would genuinely be one fix across all card lists — but the default-variety resolution and query-string serialization each exist twice, so some bugs are fixed N=2 times.

evidence: app/src/components/pokemon-cards.tsx:8-24 — cards take a narrow CardData prop; pages supply data, the component owns markup
app/src/lib/team.ts vs team-server.ts — cookie parsing is shared, the server read is isolated behind a `server-only` module, and lib/api.ts:1 guards the data layer the same way

app/src/components/team-toggle.tsx, team-remove-button.tsx, app/filters.tsx, app/pokemon/[name]/moves-table.tsx — all five client components are leaf components that receive plain values and talk only to the router
app/src/app/team/page.tsx:31 — team page re-derives a type label map from getAllTypes() instead of reusing getTypeLabels() (api.ts:190), reaching one level deeper than it needs to
app/src/components/pokemon-cards.tsx:2 — components import types from the data module '@/lib/api' (types-only, acceptable, but keeps the data layer and UI coupled at the type level)
coupling.rationale: Server/client boundaries are explicit and guarded, client components depend on narrow props, and state lives in the URL and a cookie rather than being threaded around — a few spots (team page's inline data shaping, components importing the api module for types) are slightly deeper-coupled than ideal.

evidence: app/src/lib/api.ts:258-272 — pokemonCards(refs, extra) is a real extension point: it handles all three ref shapes ({pokemon}, {pokemon,is_hidden}, learned_by_pokemon) with a callback instead of flags
app/src/components/section.tsx:6-15 — Section captures the spec's region pattern once and is reused by five pages
app/src/app/pokemon/[name]/moves-table.tsx:43-52 — column config drives the sortable table, so new columns are data, not markup
app/src/app/moves/[name]/page.tsx:60-64, abilities/[name]/page.tsx:32-36, types/[name]/page.tsx:60-64 — the '<n> Pokémon' + card-list section markup is copy-pasted three times
app/src/app/moves/[name]/page.tsx:13-27 — Props/cache-loader/generateMetadata/notFound boilerplate is repeated across all four detail pages; an Items page would clone it
abstraction_design.rationale: The abstractions that exist (pokemonCards with its extra callback, Section, the column-driven MovesTable, the split PokemonCard/PokemonCardList that let the team page compose cards with a remove button) stretch well to similar cases; what's missing is small — a shared cards-section component and a shared resource-page loader — so a new Moves-shaped Items page is mostly copy-paste of one file.

findings.issue: The 'find the species' default variety, fetch that Pokémon' resolution is duplicated verbatim from app/src/app/pokemon/[name]/page.tsx:44-49; any fix to that logic (exactly where a wrong-default-form/sprite bug would live) must be applied twice.
findings.suggestion: Extract a `getDefaultPokemon(species)` helper (or a `loadSpeciesWithPokemon(name)`) into src/lib/api.ts and use it from both pages.

findings.issue: FilterValues→URL serialization exists twice: pageHref() here and href() in app/src/app/filters.tsx:10-17, with the same omit-empty/default rules; adding a filter param (e.g. a sort param) requires editing both and they can drift silently.
findings.suggestion: Move one buildFilterHref(values, page?) into a shared module (e.g. src/app/filter-url.ts) used by both the pagination links and the client controls.

findings.issue: The team page hand-builds CardData and re-derives a type-label map inline rather than going through the data layer like every other card list, so a change to card data (e.g. sprite source) has a third construction site to remember.
findings.suggestion: Add an api.ts helper that returns members as CardData[] (plus raw type names for coverage), or reuse getTypeLabels().

findings.issue: The '<count> Pokémon' + PokemonCardList section markup is duplicated identically in the ability and type pages (abilities/[name]/page.tsx:32-36, types/[name]/page.tsx:60-64).
findings.suggestion: Extract a small <PokemonSection cards={...}> component (count + list) and reuse it in all three places.

findings.issue: Per-detail-page boilerplate (Props type, cache() loader, generateMetadata with the 'Not found' title, connection(), notFound()) is repeated across four pages with small variations (some decodeURIComponent, some lowercase), so each new resource page clones ~20 lines.
findings.suggestion: Either accept it as Next-app-router convention and keep it byte-identical, or add a tiny shared `resourceMetadata(name)` helper so the shape is at least uniform.

findings.issue: CardData.id is simultaneously the species id, the dex number, the React key and the sprite id, relying on the undocumented 'default Pokémon id == species id' invariant (CardData.name is documented, id is not).
findings.suggestion: Document the invariant on the field, or add an explicit `sprite` field so a future sprite-source change doesn't force re-plumbing every card constructor.

summary: This is a well-organized Next 16 App Router app: features are route directories, data fetching/caching/media URLs are fully contained in one server-only module, client components are leaf-level and narrow, and helpers like pokemonCards(refs, extra) and Section are genuine reuse points rather than flag-driven shells. The main editability costs are small duplications that a reviewer would ask to fold in before merge: the default-variety resolution, the filter-query serializers, the triplicated cards-section markup, and inline CardData construction on the team page. It reads like code a team can own; nothing would block the PR.
